source.description: One reviewed six-panel pencil-and-colored-pencil contact sheet cropped into five cumulative process frames and one finished master.
source.notes: The open lunchbox, food compartments, sandwich, apple, drink carton, handle, latches, seams, and shadow must remain in one stable three-quarter view. No labels or branding appear on the carton.

process_strategy: Reserve the open lid and three food footprints in the first construction, build the lunchbox hardware before the food, introduce every food silhouette before texture or color, and limit the final panel to confident line weight and restrained shading.

final_elements.name: open lunchbox base and lid
final_elements.description: A three-quarter rectangular lunchbox with a shallow base, upright open lid, rounded corners, and visible interior rim.

final_elements.name: three food compartments
final_elements.description: Three lightly reserved interior areas that prevent later food from covering finished box detail.

final_elements.name: handle and two latches
final_elements.description: One centered lid handle and two small front latches aligned to the box perspective.

final_elements.name: sandwich triangles
final_elements.description: Two stacked triangular sandwich halves in the wide left compartment.

final_elements.name: apple with stem and leaf
final_elements.description: One small round apple with a central notch, short stem, and single leaf in the front-right compartment.

final_elements.name: plain drink carton
final_elements.description: One small unbranded folded-top carton in the rear-right compartment.

final_elements.name: box seams and food texture
final_elements.description: Short corner seams, sandwich filling edges, apple contour dimples, and folded carton planes.

final_elements.name: restrained red blue and ochre pencil color
final_elements.description: Muted red on the apple, dusty blue on the lunchbox, and warm ochre on the sandwich with paper showing through.

final_elements.name: broken cast shadow
final_elements.description: A soft graphite shadow tucked beneath the lunchbox without becoming a background scene.

frames.visible_job: Uses pale graphite boxes and diagonals to establish the base, open lid, rounded corners, interior rim, and three reserved food footprints in one three-quarter view.
Traces a loose outer contour over the guides, keeps the compartment gaps open, and adds the lid handle plus two front latches.
Adds two stacked sandwich triangles, one apple with its stem and leaf, and one plain folded-top drink carton inside the reserved compartments.
Refines the established lunchbox and food contours, adds seams and small food details, then places a broken cast shadow beneath the box.
Applies dusty blue, muted red, and warm ochre pencil with directional strokes while preserving white paper highlights.
introduces: restrained red blue and ochre pencil color

final_step.visible_job: Only strengthens selected keeper contours, deepens existing graphite shadows, and tidies the already colored forms without adding new food, hardware, markings, or scenery.
allowed_changes: light eraser cleanup around established forms
small highlights within existing colored areas

rejection_checks: Keep the same open three-quarter lunchbox, crop, scale, and compartment layout in all six panels.
The sandwich, apple, and plain drink carton must all appear by Step 3 and remain in the same compartments.
Do not render finished box detail beneath the food footprints reserved in Step 1.
Do not add labels, letters, logos, faces, extra snacks, or background props.
The final panel may not introduce new food, hardware, seams, color areas, or cast-shadow shapes.
